sourceNotes.rawContent: Upgrade your look with these chic, gold-toned stainless-steel hoops featuring a unique engraved pattern. These high-fashion earrings add instant flair to any outfit. To preserve their brilliant golden finish and intricate detail, keep them away from moisture and perfumes, and store them in a dry place after use.
